fixes: Beneficiary is now called Individual everywhere

The records of single grantees are now called Individual (or Individuals) in the side menu, page titles, buttons, forms, lists, filters, reports, dashboard, notifications, messages, the Settings import and export area, the Activity Logs and the user manual. Older Activity Log entries show the new name too. One consistent name for the same thing, so staff are no longer switching between two words
Group wording kept as it was

Words about the people inside a group project, such as Total, Male and Female Beneficiaries and DOLE's Type of Beneficiaries list, and the CQPR column headings are unchanged. Official terms and the CQPR format stay as DOLE expects
Web addresses and saved data unchanged
Only the words on screen changed. Page addresses, saved records and existing links keep working exactly as before. No broken bookmarks and nothing to move or re-enter
